calls.title: GrowthBook Enterprise Trial — Ryanair
calls.summary: The client is assessing the feasibility of migrating from existing experimentation tools to GrowthBook, emphasizing the integration complexity and feature parity required. A trial setup aims to evaluate migration effort, particularly with web hook integrations and production challenges. Key stakeholders from development and infrastructure teams will be engaged sequentially before involving BI teams to ensure technical feasibility. Current challenges in the existing experimentation structure, such as scalability issues, are being addressed through a shift to attribute-based experiment matching, allowing for better management and flexibility. The aim is to consolidate experimentation platforms to improve efficiency for both developers and BI teams, with a cloud-hosted trial to expedite evaluation and feedback.
calls.keywords: Aviation, Experimentation, Feature Flags, Migration, Trial Account, Hosting
